title: Papa's Freezeria
subtitle: Build the perfect ice cream sundae before the timer runs out.

instructions.title: How to play
items: Customers arrive in a queue — serve them in order, first come first served.
Pick the right size, flavor, syrup & topping. Aim for ~6 syrup drizzles and ~5 topping drops for max points.
Speed matters! You get full time bonus under 20s. Points decay after that — finish before 90s or lose the bonus entirely.

steps.title: Serve the queue
steps.body: Customers line up. Serve them in order — first come, first served.
